capability.title: Maturity Refactor and Platform Readiness
capability.outcome: The local batch product reaches explicit maturity, then is refactored in bounded slices before cloud/event expansion.
acceptance_criteria: Refactor inventory and staged plan precede implementation.
validation: Scorecards, architecture tests and staged full-suite green.

stories.title: FREEZE-002 Maturity Scorecard and Entry Gate
stories.outcome: Maturity percentages derive from explicit evidence and weak lanes have owners.
acceptance_criteria: Each lane has metric, evidence age, threshold and blocker.
Entry gate confirms V1 proof exists.

stories.title: REFACTOR-001A Runtime Inventory and Risk Map
stories.outcome: Scripts, modules, migrations, scheduler, reports, UI, tests and docs are classified before refactoring.
acceptance_criteria: Responsibility, mutation, cloud, audit, defect and coverage fields populated.

stories.title: REFACTOR-001B Module Boundary Plan
stories.outcome: Target services and handoffs are defined without a monolithic rewrite.
acceptance_criteria: Discovery, evidence, candidate/gate, connector, ops, reporting, UI and governance boundaries mapped.

stories.title: REFACTOR-001C Defect and Stop Alignment
stories.outcome: Stop, repair, scheduler, report and runtime failure vocabularies align.

stories.title: REFACTOR-001D Cloud/Event Readiness Pass
stories.outcome: Stable IDs, timestamps, idempotency, provenance and outbox-ready vocabulary are verified.
acceptance_criteria: No hidden export inputs or local-only blockers remain undocumented.

stories.title: REFACTOR-001E Staged Implementation
stories.outcome: Small refactor PRs reduce duplication and clarify services while preserving behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Each slice has rollback and full validation.

stories.title: Cloud-Ready Batch Foundation
stories.outcome: Current batch pipeline can run in a managed environment without changing product semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Configuration, secrets, storage, scheduling and observability contracts are portable.

stories.title: DB-Backed Outbox and Event Foundation
stories.outcome: Domain changes can be published reliably without direct Kafka coupling.
acceptance_criteria: Event IDs, ordering, retries and audit semantics defined.

stories.title: Kafka Event Backbone
stories.outcome: Kafka is introduced only for proven event-streaming value.
acceptance_criteria: Concrete consumers, throughput and replay use cases justify it.

stories.title: Spark Analytics Replay or Feature Layer
stories.outcome: Spark is used only for measurable analytical/replay value.
acceptance_criteria: Use case exceeds simpler SQL/Python alternatives.

stories.title: Sustainability and Compliance KPI Maturity
stories.outcome: Lifecycle, cost, energy and compliance-readiness measures become explicit when operationally useful.
acceptance_criteria: KPIs have source, owner and decision use.
